art_direction: No Zoan face. Two asymmetric gold lunar-growth motifs. Three uniquely redesigned spatial spirit trees. Data-only touch UI.
limitations: Concept paintings are 2D references and cannot be exactly reconstructed as 3D from one camera angle without hand-authored production assets.
No physical Android FPS, memory, thermal or battery testing.
The inherited 146-entry database is not independently audited as a complete current canonical listing.
23 historically illustrated forms remain stylised, 123 remain sealed as unverified.
CDN preview availability is separate from GitHub file verification; do not infer it from tests.

scoring_subjective.note: Visual match is subjective; model remains below requested studio-quality reference art.

design_decisions: Removed all active Zoan face and facial components permanently
Kept only two integrated asymmetric ancient gold lunar/cambium arcs
Rebuilt broad spatial oak crowns and supporting side/rear branches; increased representative hanging-fruit scale
Reformed Logia around joined basalt, heat and storm branches, swirling purple storm and iceberg/wind masses
Interwove cream and blush Paramecia boughs with thick spatial sakura crowns, two gold rings and rooted portal
Rebuilt all three multi-tier floating island types and attached tapering water sheeting
Added sparse 3D distant faceted clouds and quiet class-tinted atmospheric backgrounds
Revised angular facet palettes to reduce stripe banding; reduced repetitive fire fans and blossom spikes
Changed family camera to preserve active branch/fruit context instead of extremely close bark crops
Preserved data-only typography and finger-first gestures with native small icon controls
remaining_gap: The three sculptures still look algorithmically generated rather than manually production-sculpted; cannot claim award-winning exactness
Clouds, foliage, ice and fire lack the material complexity, painted facet work and artistic lighting in reference illustrations
Individual canon fruit looks not independently audited against primary manga reference
Physical Android touch and thermal/performance tests not performed
RawGitHack CDN accessibility not independently confirmed
